feedback: Approved for the race. The candidate sits on the iteration 3 base (score 361.4, the best raced so far): same sensors (x = -0.06 to 0.06 m, y 0.06, sensor_size 0.012), kp 2.5, ki 0.02, and last_direction line loss. It changes two controller levers at once: base_speed 1.1 to 1.3, and kd 0.8 to 1.0. The rationale calls the kd change single-variable, but the speed change is also a change from iteration 3, so any shift in results cannot be attributed to one lever. Iteration 2 showed that confounded changes are hard to read, so the next critique should rely on per-track numbers rather than the aggregate score. The evidence supports the speed change. Iteration 1 at base_speed 1.3 finished the oval in 1.89 s, and iteration 3 at 1.1 showed that lower speed reduced bend progress (s-bend 0.27 to 0.22, slalom 0.18 to 0.10). The kd change is supported by the bend overshoot in iterations 1 and 3 (max_error about 0.062 to 0.063 m, just above the 0.06 m off-track limit). The oval is the main risk: iteration 1 at speed 1.3 with the narrower span finished 18 of 20, so a higher speed on the wider span could cost oval finishes. Review the race as follows. If oval completion holds at 1.0 and the bends still end off track with max_error at or above 0.06 m, the damping is not the limit. Next, lower kp only if steering_oscillation rises, or change line_loss or sensor y position to address the slalom line loss. If the bends improve (max_error below 0.05 m, progress above 0.3) while oval completion stays at 1.0, keep this controller and tune for completion. If the oval drops below 0.9 completion, return base_speed to about 1.2.
requested_changes: If the oval completion falls below 0.9 at base_speed 1.3: set base_speed to about 1.2 and keep kd 1.0, since iteration 3 (speed 1.1) finished the oval 20 of 20 and iteration 1 (speed 1.3) finished 18 of 20.

If the s-bend and slalom still go off track with max_error at or above 0.06 m and line_loss_events near 1: change the sensor y position (for example from 0.06 to 0.08 m, the allowed maximum) to give the controller earlier warning at the bend entry, rather than adjusting kp alone.

If steering_oscillation on the oval rises above about 0.3 (iteration 2 at kp 3.0 with kd 1.0 reached 0.27): lower kp from 2.5 to about 2.0 while keeping kd 1.0, to test whether the damping is now too strong relative to the proportional term.
